item_short_desc: Protect your face from heat and flames with Rothco’s Fire Retardant Tactical Hood.
description: Protect your face from heat and flames with Rothco’s Fire Retardant Tactical Hood. Our FR hood is constructed with 100% meta-aramid interlock, a highly flame and heat resistant fabric. This tactical hood is heat and flame resistant up to 700 degrees. The fire retardant hood weighs 8 ounces for a comfortable and long-term wear. One size fits most – this workwear hood measures 15 inches in length to cover your face and neck.
